recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to organizer usage or additional grouping patterns should follow separate final Jira decisions rather than reopening this DSTU2 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-11822 asked for clearer guidance on how to represent observation panels and batteries across DiagnosticReport and Observation. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said best practice varies by use case and realm, but the relevant section should be clarified, with related component-use work in FHIR-10038.
initial_application: The issue was already applied historically. Commit 687bf7399e was explicitly tagged [#11822] and expanded Observation notes with panel/battery guidance. Related FHIR-10038 commits d20fec3441, 0909c366e0, and def17105a1 rewrote the same guidance around DiagnosticReport.result, Observation.component, and Observation-related grouping. Later commit 5bdc655967 updated the related mechanism to Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom.
additional_context: Later final OO work refined but did not reverse the guidance. FHIR-39168/FHIR-40540 added Diagnostics Module parent/child guidance; FHIR-50138 added Observation.organizer for hasMember-based organizer/groupers; and R6 no-change decisions FHIR-55019, FHIR-54562, and FHIR-54808 rejected adding List/Group as another DiagnosticReport.result grouping option. Confluence minutes show ongoing realm-specific variation, but no final conflicting decision was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source already explains DiagnosticReport.result grouping, Observation.component for inseparable components, Observation.hasMember for panels/batteries whose member Observations stand alone, Observation.derivedFrom for derived observations, and linked Diagnostics Module parent/child reporting guidance.
